created_for: Startup Sim Godot G1/G3 main office scene
storage_policy: Primary copy lives inside godot/StartupSimGodot/assets/art. External D:/美术资源/startup-sim copy is backup only.

source_tooling.transparency: opaque background image retained as RGBA for Godot compatibility

grid_intent.role: full-scene background under office grid, zones, facilities, employees, overlays, and HUD
grid_intent.buildable_area_hint: central open office floor; walls and exterior detail are decorative boundaries

godot_import.suggested_usage: Sprite2D/TextureRect background layer below interactive office objects
godot_import.filter: nearest or linear depending on final camera scale; avoid mipmapped blur for pixel-readable UI overlays

notes: No baked text, logos, people, UI, or fixed central furniture.
The background is intentionally mostly empty so the integration session can place zones and facilities on top.
This is not a transparent cutout asset; corner alpha is expected to be opaque.
